schema: hn-integrations/0 (PROPOSED by WS-PLUG, see pm/reports; app-events §6)
paths: ~ = user home (%USERPROFILE% on Windows). Merge ops keep every entry that is not ours; ours = a hook whose command (or command+args) starts with `marker`.

claude.name: Claude Code

preferred.note: `claude` may only exist inside the Claude desktop app (%APPDATA%/Claude/claude-code/<ver>/claude.exe); use that path when it is not on PATH.

fallback.note: Claude installs it on its next start. UNVERIFIED: WS-APP to confirm.

claude.manual: In Claude: + next to the prompt box > Plugins > Add marketplace `human-needed/plugins` > install humanneeded. Or in a terminal: claude plugin marketplace add human-needed/plugins, then claude plugin install humanneeded@humanneeded. New sessions light the puck.

codex.name: Codex

install.after: Codex runs new hooks only after the user trusts them: tell the user to open Codex and approve them (CLI: /hooks; app: Settings > Hooks or the 'Review hooks' prompt). Can't be automated (trust is per hook hash).

codex.manual: Copy the entries of plugins/codex/hooks/hooks.json (github.com/human-needed/plugins) into ~/.codex/hooks.json (create it if missing), restart Codex, then approve the hooks in /hooks (CLI) or Settings > Hooks (app).
codex.restart_needed: new sessions; hooks must be trusted

cursor.name: Cursor

install.note: Create the file as {"version":1,"hooks":{}} when missing. Cursor reloads it on save.

cursor.manual: Add the entries of plugins/cursor/hooks.json (github.com/human-needed/plugins) to ~/.cursor/hooks.json (create it with {"version": 1, "hooks": {}} if missing). Cursor picks it up at once.
